expectations.text: A noisy oracle goal condition is added to the config (a new goal_info value and/or noise std keys) with a comment, and the default behaviour of existing goal_info values is unchanged.
expectations.evidence: New goal_info value noisy_oracle plus an information.goal_noise block (distance_noise 20.0, bearing_noise_deg 15.0) with comments; the default goal_info stays none.

expectations.text: The noise is applied in a vectorised way over all envs (no Python loop over envs) and the goal information slot keeps its 5-dim size.
expectations.evidence: goal_features draws torch.randn(num_envs, 2) and fills the same 5-dim slot; no loop over envs.

expectations.text: The new setting (the condition and its noise std) ends up in variant_name in scripts/train.py or is otherwise guaranteed to be part of the storage name.
expectations.evidence: variant_name appends the stds when goal_info == noisy_oracle; also adds a W&B tag.

expectations.text: The run executes a smoke training run or a focused test that exercises the new condition, and reports the result.
expectations.evidence: 15 tests pass, plus smoke runs for MLP, LSTM and GRU with noisy_oracle.

expectations.text: No git commit or push is made.
expectations.evidence: git log has only harness commits; changes are uncommitted.
